title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.65
summary: Improves trailer matching and fixes empty streaming-service shelves.

sections.heading: Previews
bullets: Use release years and verified season titles to distinguish similar movies and shows.
Keep credible trailer matches when their titles omit the year.

sections.heading: Streaming services
bullets: Skip shelves when the service has no matching titles in your region.
Keep the previous row visible during loading and offer Retry for failed requests.
